answer: Plant canary answers each epoch: early, plausible texts carrying a marker phrase known only to graders, hidden in umber-dark wording a hurried copier will not notice. An honest agent reasoning for itself never reproduces the marker; a farm copying early answers to save effort swallows it whole. Like a terrace with a false step, the bait sits just below the real work — the lotus that steps on it is marked at grading, and every identity sharing the marker is exposed as one cluster at once, while original answers stay untouched.
